title: Seeking Riverbed Consultants
description:

As a consultant for Riverbed's product suite, you will solve clients enterprise-wide network, application, and server capacity and performance issues. These positions combine engineering disciplines with a business focus for delivering IT performance management solutions. You will utilize Riverbed's technologies to plan, design, deploy, operate, manage and optimize IT infrastructures.

• Serve as an expert in cloud migration, WAN optimization, networking and application performance, and/or applications delivery, utilizing Riverbeds complete Application Performance portfolio

• Provide specialized planning and design expertise in data center consolidation and data migration, network configuration and analysis, application performance troubleshooting and/or optimization

• Analyze and understand customers IT organization, requirements and processes, and use this knowledge to assist in achieving full adoption and utilization of Clients solutions to maximize ROI and business value

• Present and articulate advanced product features, benefits, and overall product solutions

• Produce solutions to fulfill customer needs within budget and schedule constraints

• Work directly with customers, colleagues and other stakeholders to achieve project goals

Desired Technical Skills:

• Solid understanding of TCP/IP and network design, protocols, components and operations; multi-tier application architectures; and/or the internal workings of J2EE and .NET

• Strong knowledge of web application architecture and software including Web Servers (Apache, IIS), J2EE Application Servers (Websphere, Weblogic), Databases (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2) and/or Operating Systems (UNIX, Windows)

• Installation and configuration experience with ESX, VMFS, storage sub-systems, cache architectures and windowing systems

• Experience with protocol analyzers, WireShark, NetFlow and/or packet analysis

• Knowledge of Python and/or other scripting languages (ruby, perl, RESTful APIs)

Qualifications
Many roles required various security clearances. Please be sure to specify your current, active security clearance.

• Experience with Splunk, Cisco, Juniper, Cryptos, Palo Alto, ArcSIGHT, and Nessus Vulnerability scanning and RMF

• Experience with Riverbed Tools (SteelHead, AppResponse, Profiler, NETIM, NetCollector, NetAuditor, Aternity)

• Minimum DOD 8140/ DOD 8570 IAT Level II Certification (examples include: A+ CE, CCNA-Security, Security+, Network+ CE, CISSP, CASP, or SSCP)

• BS/MS degree in a technical field, or equivalent military or career experience

• CCNA (routing, switching) preferred

• SD-WAN experience preferred

• Experience in professional services, technical consulting, or network engineering/operations preferred

• Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences, drive IT projects forward in large organizations, and translate technical features into tangible customer business benefits

• Self-motivated and capable of high performance under minimal supervision

• Excellent business writing and presentation skills

• Professionalism appropriate for working with Fortune 500 clients

Passion for teamwork and contributing to a world-class Professional Services team which values excellence, execution, and integrity﻿
﻿ ﻿﻿﻿

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Salary: Depending on Experience﻿
﻿

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.
Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.
As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.
Join our team now!
Job Description
Work at Home Bilingual Tzotzil-English Phone Interpreter
Job Title: Tzotzil Interpreter
Location: Work at Home position in United States
Position: Phone Interpreter
Status: Independent Contractor
Pay: $1.30 - $1.45 per minute
We Offer:

• Employee Referral Program.

• Advancement opportunities within the organization.

• Interpreter support.

• An inclusive and diverse work environment.

• **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:
The Tzotzil Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Tzotzil and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.
The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.
This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.
**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**
Essential Job Functions

• Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.

• Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.

• Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.

• Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.

• Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.

• Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.

title: CRO & UX Analyst
description:
CRO & UX Analyst
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 5+ Years
Schedule: Must be available for overlap with Sydney hours, including availability from 2:00 PM AESTWhy this role matters
We're hiring someone to help take our client to the next level. This is not a freelance or contract role. You'll be all in with our team and our clients from day one.
We want a motivated person who lifts the team and inspires our clients. You have a can-do attitude. You believe every data problem can be solved, and you keep going until it is.

The role
You'll find out what users do once they land on a client's site, and why they don't convert. You'll spend most of your day in GA4 and behavioural tools like Hotjar, Contentsquare, FullStory or Microsoft Clarity. You'll also step back to spot trends and patterns, and explain what they mean for the client's business. You'll work closely with our senior CRO and CRO team.

Here's a typical task. A client's conversion rate dropped 15% last month. You work out which channel, device and landing page drove the drop. You check the ratios behind it, such as add-to-cart and checkout completion rates. Then you watch session recordings and heatmaps to see what users did. Then you write up the likely cause, what it's costing the client, and what to test. If the numbers look wrong, you check for a tracking issue first.

This role is not
We've had many applicants from adjacent fields. They're good backgrounds, but they're not this job. This role is not:

• A tracking or tag setup role. Our developers handle implementation.

• An A/B test build or development role. You'll analyse test results, but you won't build the tests.

• A UX or UI design role.

• A campaign, SEO, PPC or media reporting role. We care about what users do on the site, not how they got there.

• A data science role. Python, SQL and BigQuery aren't required. If you have them, tell us how they'd add to the skills below, not replace them

What you'll do
GA4 analysis (the core of the role)

• Build custom reports and explorations in GA4 to answer specific client questions.

• Build funnel and path explorations to find where users drop off.

• Create segments and comparisons, such as new vs returning, device, channel or landing page.

• Find which pages, sources or user groups explain a change in conversion rate.

Business-level analysis

• Spot trends and patterns over time, such as week-on-week, year-on-year and seasonal shifts.

• Work with ratios, not just totals. For example: conversion rate, average order value, revenue per user, add-to-cart rate, and cart-to-checkout and checkout completion rates.

• Tell a real change apart from noise or a shift in traffic mix.

• Link site metrics to business outcomes like revenue, leads and lead quality.

• Size opportunities. For example, what a 1% lift in checkout completion is worth to the client per year.

A/B test results and post-test analysis
This is critical to our business. We need to know why a test won or lost, not just that it did.

• Analyse A/B test results and report them clearly, including confidence and sample size.

• Break results down by segment, such as device, new vs returning, channel and landing page.

• Dig into secondary metrics and funnel steps to explain what changed in user behaviour.

• Use recordings and heatmaps of each variant to show why it won or lost.

• Turn the findings into clear next steps and new test ideas.

Behavioural and UX analysis

• Review session recordings, heatmaps and scroll maps to see what users actually do.

• Run heuristic reviews of client sites and funnels to spot likely conversion blockers.

• Check findings across GA4, behavioural tools and heuristics. Don't rely on one source.

Data quality

• Spot when data looks wrong, such as missing events, duplicates, thresholding or sampling.

• Work out whether it's a tracking issue.

• Brief our developers clearly so they can fix it. You won't do the fix yourself.

description:
About Multi Media, LLC
Multi Media, LLC is the company behind Chaturbate, one of the most heavily trafficked live streaming platforms in the world. We support a global network of independent content creators and millions of real-time viewers, delivering interactive video at scale. Our infrastructure handles complex broadcasting, low-latency streaming, and high-engagement user experiences. All live, all the time.
We’re building a platform where creators can express themselves freely and grow their communities, where viewers discover and interact with creators they’re drawn to, and where the team behind it is challenged, trusted, and responsible for shaping the experience of millions of users worldwide. We value people who take initiative, stay curious, and care deeply about the quality and impact of what they build.
The Role
We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who specializes in frontend performance tuning and optimization. You will join the Viewer team, which is responsible for delivering high-traffic experiences across search, video, site navigation, and other core areas of Chaturbate.
This role requires deeper performance expertise than a typical frontend engineering position. You will investigate how browsers execute and render our applications, profile production bottlenecks, analyze memory usage, and identify the code paths causing delays or instability. As the role evolves, you may have opportunities to apply your expertise to other high-impact frontend experiences and help shape how we approach performance across Engineering.
What You’ll Do

• Diagnosing, triaging, and leading to resolution issues involving unnecessary renders, long tasks, memory leaks, forced reflows, layout shifts, expensive painting, and excessive JavaScript execution.

• Define and improve measurable performance targets using real-user monitoring, Lighthouse, synthetic testing, Chrome DevTools traces, and product-level business metrics.

• Establish performance budgets, dashboards, and alerts

• Raise the performance capabilities of the broader organization through technical talks, workshops, documentation, mentoring, code reviews, and reusable tooling.

Requirements
You Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent practical experience)

• Deep expertise in modern front-end frameworks (React, Angular, Vue, Svelte, etc), TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with experience operating in a front-end heavy high-traffic consumer web application.

• Expert-level proficiency with Chrome DevTools, React Profiler, Lighthouse, CPU profiles, flame charts, network waterfalls, and performance traces.

• Senior-level technical leadership skills, including identifying high-impact work independently, influencing architecture decisions, and advising teams outside your immediate area

• Strong understanding of browser internals, including JavaScript execution, style calculation, layout, painting, rasterization, and compositing

• Proven experience improving Core Web Vitals, including Largest Contentful Paint, Interaction to Next Paint, and Cumulative Layout Shift using real-user data.

• Hands-on experience diagnosing memory leaks using heap snapshots, allocation profiles, garbage-collection analysis, and detached DOM-node detection.

• Ability to optimize rendering, hydration, bundle size, code splitting, main-thread work, third-party scripts, and frontend asset delivery.

Benefits
You’ll Get

• Competitive compensation with performance bonuses

• Fully remote option

• Health, vision, dental, and life insurance for you and any dependents, with policy premiums covered by the company

• Long- & short-term disability insurance

• Unlimited PTO

• Annual year-end company closure

• Optional 401k with 5% matching

• 12 paid holidays

• Paid lunches in-office; if remote, a $125/week stipend via Sharebite

• EAP and employee recognition programs

Databricks is looking for a Senior Collections Analyst to own a high-volume accounts receivable (AR) portfolio in a fast-growing, usage-based SaaS business. The role drives timely collections, reduces delinquency, protects cash flow and leads recovery on complex, high-value accounts, while helping shape credit risk decisions. Working closely with Sales, Legal, Billing, Revenue Operations, Cash Application and Finance leadership to resolve disputes, billing gaps and customer escalations, the role has a measurable impact on DSO and bad debt exposure and requires regular overlap with EMEA and PST business hours.

 

Job Description

• Own end-to-end portfolio collections and recovery strategies, partnering cross-functionally to resolve high-value escalations, influence credit risk decisions, and drive measurable performance across DSO, aging buckets, and bad debt exposure.

• Design and run recovery strategies for accounts that are structurally delinquent or high-risk.

• Lead cross-functional escalation forums for disputed high-value accounts.

• Present portfolio-level risk trends and actionable insights to Finance leadership.

• Recommend credit limit changes, payment term changes or account holds based on behavioral analytics.

• Help standardize collections processes so they are faster and can scale, and support user acceptance testing (UAT) for new or improved systems.

 

Requirements

title: Graduate Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
COMPANY

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

HIRING NOW

We are hiring as soon as possible. This role is for someone who has already graduated, or who will complete their degree in time to start with us very soon. We are not able to consider final-year students who graduate in summer 2027 or later, and this is not a graduate scheme with a fixed annual intake.

Role Overview

This is a first full-time engineering role on the NEO-1 satellite. You will design satellite hardware and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised as the design matures, learning from our lead designer and working in a small, multidisciplinary team. You will take ownership of real parts early, translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, such as brackets, panels, component mounts, thermal-control hardware and cable and harness routing, with guidance from the lead designer.

- Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, learning how to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model.

- Support design reviews (PDR and CDR) and qualification, working with structural and thermal engineers.

- Work with manufacturers and suppliers to make designs easier to build, and to balance cost, mass and reliability.

- Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results.

- Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline, completed or completing very soon.

- Hands-on 3D CAD skills from university projects, a placement or an internship (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered).

- Working knowledge of GD&T and experience producing engineering drawings, including from coursework or a team project.

- Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics.

- Evidence of designing, building and testing something real, such as a placement project, Formula Student, a UAV, or a rocketry or satellite team, including troubleshooting and iteration.

- Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

- A placement, internship or year in industry in aerospace, space, motorsport or another high-reliability field.

- Experience of several people working in one CAD assembly, for example in a Formula Student or university team, including how files and revisions were controlled.

OpenAI, in close collaboration with our capital and delivery partners, is building the infrastructure required to support frontier AI systems. - Knowledge of applicable NEC, NFPA, IEEE, NERC, and utility requirements.
